acceptance: Membership and board access are distinct: non-Owners require both; invitations grant no boards automatically. Owner administers board grants; Manager receives creator access to a board they create. UI and APIs disclose current effective access without hidden-board metadata.
decision: Local integration accepted using current mounted PostgreSQL/Node/workerd and applicable actual UI/helper/browser evidence, with source and phase bindings checked. Real Google/mail/R2/cron/Claude and native browser-menu zoom are not claimed by synthetic checks.
